# `.github/`

GitHub configuration: workflows, the deploy helper script and code ownership.

| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`CODEOWNERS`](CODEOWNERS) | Makes `@jagadishmazure-jpg` the owner of every path, so pull requests request that review |
| [`workflows/`](workflows/README.md) | CI (lint, tests, eval and doctrine gates, doc drift), infra checks, gated deploy and teardown |
| [`scripts/`](scripts/README.md) | The deploy helper the deploy workflow calls |
